## Proposed objective

Correct issue #68 (bug: every Q&A action also logs a session_viewed (redirect back to the session page)): Q&A requests that redirect back and administrator calendar edits must not add false page-view events, while true page navigation still creates exactly one view event.

## Boundary

The correction is within CHG-54 (Extend the Activity Log to signed-in user activity), which calls for preventing duplicate false positives. Include successful and failed Q&A actions, the administrator calendar edit redirect, their focused follow-redirect regression tests, and the existing activity-logging operations note. Confirm the actual client/redirect mechanism in Design before picking an implementation. Preserve real navigation, action events, existing roles and access checks, event schema, and historical rows. Issue #69 (bug: activity-log prefetch guard checks X-Inertia-Prefetch, but Inertia sends Purpose: prefetch) is separate and awaiting review.

## Acceptance and evidence

1. Successful and failed Q&A actions followed through redirects produce no additional `session_viewed` row.
2. A real session page visit still records exactly one `session_viewed` row.
3. An administrator calendar edit followed through its redirect produces no `calendar_viewed` row; a real calendar visit still records one.
4. Feature tests use `followingRedirects()`, and the maintained activity-logging guidance reflects the result.
5. A safe screenshot shows the corrected activity view with synthetic `.test` data before any PR publication.

ISS-24 (Q&A and calendar action redirects inflate session and calendar view activity) and ACT-84 (Correct and verify duplicate activity views after Q&A and calendar redirects) are In Progress. ACT-80 (Verify event attribution and coverage, absence of false prefetch/duplicate entries and sensitive metadata, user/action/date filtering, administrator-only access, and relevant regressions) remains Open. DEP-10 (Gate 1 environment and ownership evidence for credible staging and production planning) remains Open; staging deployment and production are outside this local cycle.
